correctness.rationale: The source itself gives the factorization (r1-lambda)(lambda^2-B1 lambda+B2)=0 at P4 with r1>0, B1<0 and B2>0. Hence one eigenvalue is positive and the other two have negative real part: if real, positive product and negative sum force both negative; if complex, their real part is B1/2<0. Thus P4 is a hyperbolic index-one saddle and cannot be a saddle-node, which requires a zero eigenvalue at the critical equilibrium. The transverse invasion exponent of the absent first prey is exactly r1.
